reason_codes.meaning: The complete final bilingual Legal Location fits both exact serving ceilings and remains one record candidate.
Recursive complete official bilingual units produced the minimum-part earliest-full canonical partition and every final part fits both ceilings.
Two or more distinct Legal Locations were independently rendered and measured, with no aggregate serving part or cross-location combination.

An unsafe new Official Version is quarantined and one evidence-backed ADR 0005 carry-forward, complete withholding, or no-jurisdiction-rebuild decision is validated without silent predecessor reuse or retirement.
The smallest complete supported bilingual branch and its required dependencies exceed a hard ceiling, so the branch is quarantined with a Coverage Gap.
A source element or dependency relationship has unknown published meaning and no split boundary is guessed.
A proposed official boundary cannot be proved in both authentic-language trees under the accepted alignment.
The final payload does not preserve exact ownership by the declared Legal Location.
Primary source-unit coverage is missing, duplicated, reordered, or otherwise not exact-once.
The implementation failed to produce the required canonical minimum-part result from otherwise valid inputs.
